title: Professional services time entries into the vendor accrual workbook
prompt: Extract time entries from professional services invoices, separate work date from invoice date, and update the existing vendor accrual workbook.

inputs.name: Itemized professional services invoices with time entries

steps: read every invoice; run column_map over the itemized time entries (headers never positions) and save the mapping to data/ps-invoice-columns.json
for each time entry keep the work date, hours, rate and amount separately from the invoice date; a line with hours but no dollars is flagged, never allocated
group entries by vendor and by the month the work was done; compare with the accrual already in the workbook for that month
run xlsx_update_in_place to add or adjust the workbook rows for the period, keeping every existing row, formula and sheet; the updated copy is a deliverable
propose cutoff adjustments (tier B) where fees for prior-period work were expensed in the current period or the reverse
tie: the workbook total for the period equals the invoice lines allocated to it plus the flagged lines listed apart

done.text: The updated vendor accrual workbook exists as a deliverable with its original sheets kept and the period's rows added or adjusted
The invoice time-entry columns were mapped by header with no ambiguous or missing required column
Every exception row cites the invoice id, the invoice line and the workbook row it updated
ps-accrual-cutoff.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Every proposed cutoff adjustment balances to the penny
Work date and invoice date are separate columns on every entry; hours without dollars are flagged as exceptions and never allocated an amount; no existing workbook row is removed

tierRules.when: a cutoff adjustment moving professional fees between periods by work date

deliverables.name: Vendor accrual workbook (updated).xlsx
sheets: (the workbook's own sheets, updated in place)
